design: the paper's: scCOSMiX's copula correlation with the patients as random effects, the myeloid cells of 8 responders' breast biopsies before and after nab-paclitaxel with or without atezolizumab, 5,018 cells (2,215 before, 2,803 after)
notes: the deposit is one SingleCellExperiment of 56,180 myeloid cells of 44 patients (results/level-b-rdescribe-2: its cells' metadata; its counts a dense matrix), exported by r_export.R in the data job; the cells are the paper's filter (its section on the TNBC data set): biopsies of breast tissue, nab-paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel plus atezolizumab (the deposit's Treatment 'Nab-PTX' and 'Nab-PTX+Anti-PD-L1'), responders (Response 'R'), patients with at least 30 myeloid cells both before and after; the groups the deposit's Group; the deposit names no batch, platform or chemistry beyond its samples (a patient's biopsy before or after), so no source is named; the genes are taken as the object names them (its rownames; were they not symbols, the export's log names its rowData's columns).
